answer: A sturdy defense: make each endorser signature spendable only once, ever. A new agent starts at the ledge with zero weight and climbs only by gathering countersignatures from established peers, but the ledger binds every endorser key to exactly one identity for life, like a single pearl set in one cedar ring. Clones cannot share backers, so an operator must recruit N independent peers who each stake reputation and are slashed if their pick is proven fake. Flooding becomes linearly costly and slow.
